name: eyes-reference
description: The eye companion pack, poststruct side: every image referenced by a baked page's social markup (og:image, twitter:image) must be a REAL image the reviewers and scrapers see - file exists, magic bytes parse as PNG/JPEG/SVG, PNG dimensions from the IHDR header agree with declared og:image:width/height, byte-size plausible, and SVG references rasterize clean through the eyestruct raster gate (the interop direction). The og-image escape-soup receipt, turned into a pack.
